title: An Efficient Approach to Beetle Damage Detection of Banana Using Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visible surface damage of banana fruits by Basilepta subcostata (the banana fruit scarring beetle) can reduce their market value. Here, manual inspection of Banana fruits is subjective and difficult to scale. This study presents a lightweight framework based on YOLOv8n deep learning model for locating individual bananas and classifying their visible surface condition as healthy or unhealthy. The term beetle damage in the paper title is used operationally for the locally observed scar-like surface condition; the model does not identify a specific beetle species or biological cause. A custom dataset of 2,473 images containing 5,827 annotated banana instances was prepared from local-market imagery in Bangladesh. The reported experiment used an 80/20 protocol with 1,982 training images and 491 test images. A pretrained YOLOv8n model was trained at 640x640 resolution for 50 epochs with a batch size of 4. translated_title: 基于深度学习的香蕉甲虫损伤高效检测方法
translated_abstract: 香蕉果实因香蕉果实疤痕甲虫造成的可见表面损伤会降低其市场价值。目前对香蕉果实的人工检查既主观又难以规模化。本研究提出了一种基于YOLOv8n深度学习模型的轻量级框架，用于定位单个香蕉并将其可见表面状况分类为健康或不健康。论文标题中的“甲虫损伤”一词是针对当地观察到的疤痕状表面状况的操作性用语；该模型并不识别特定的甲虫种类或生物学成因。研究基于孟加拉国当地市场的图像，构建了一个包含2,473张图像、5,827个标注香蕉实例的自定义数据集。所报告的实验采用80/20划分协议，包含1,982张训练图像和491张测试图像。预训练的YOLOv8n模型在640x640分辨率下训练了50个epoch，批大小为4。在测试集上，该模型取得了8（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出基于YOLOv8n的轻量级深度学习框架，利用孟加拉国本地市场自建数据集（2,473张图像、5,827个标注实例）实现香蕉果实定位及表面健康状况的自动分类。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a lightweight YOLOv8n-based deep learning framework that uses a custom dataset from Bangladesh local markets (2,473 images with 5,827 annotated instances) to locate individual bananas and automatically classify their surface condition as healthy or unhealthy.
